title: Apply FOIL distribution to the product
text: $$\left(3x-1\right) \left(4y+2\right)$$ expands the first term is 12xy, the outer term is $$6x$$, the inner term is $$-4y$$, and the last term is $$-2$$. Note that this is equivalent to $$12xy+6x-4y-2$$ which appears in the options.

title: Factor out a common multiple
text: Observe that we can factor out the term $$(3x-1)$$ from the expression $$4y\left(3x-1\right)+2\left(3x-1\right)$$ to give $$\left(3x-1\right) \left(4y+2\right)$$ which also appears as one of the terms.

title: Expand out with distribution
text: Expand out $$6x\left(y-1\right)-4y+2$$ to get $$6xy-6x-4y+2$$, which is not equivalent to the expression $$12xy+6x-4y-2$$ that appears as a choice. This must be the incorrect expression!
